name: start_destination_only_blit
description: Calls a routine first, then loads the blitter first-word mask, a control word that enables only the destination channel with no shift, a zero destination modulo, the destination pointer and a small blit size, which starts the operation.

name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Polls a status byte at a fixed offset from an address register and loops while its busy bit is set, returning once the blitter is idle.

name: reset_text_cursor_state
description: Points the character stream pointer at a fixed start address, clears the column counter, sets the line counter to one and clears a flag byte, preparing the decoder for a new run of text.

name: advance_text_stream_cursor
description: Reads the next byte of a character stream. Zero bytes are skipped, the marker byte rewinds the stream to its start, and a carriage return or a full 41-column line starts a new line; other characters go to a called routine and advance the column counter.

name: step_text_stream_column
description: Advances the column counter and starts a new line at 41 columns. It then reads the byte at the stream pointer: zero bytes are skipped, the marker byte rewinds the stream, and other characters go to a called routine that moves the stream on.

name: start_new_text_line
description: Resets the column counter and advances the line counter, then reads the byte at the stream pointer. Zero bytes are skipped, the marker byte rewinds the stream, and other characters go to a called routine that moves the stream on.

name: configure_blit_bit_alignment
description: Calls a routine, then sets the blitter first-word mask and control word from the low bits of two position values. When the first value is even and the second odd, it also offsets the source and destination pointers by a fixed amount and uses a different blit size; otherwise it uses the standard size.

name: copy_paired_words_from_records
description: Writes two fixed longword headers at the start of two tables, then copies the first two words of each of 64 six-word source records into the first table and the second table respectively.

name: copy_paired_words_second_bank
description: Calls a routine, then writes two fixed longword headers at the start of a second pair of tables and copies the first two words of 64 six-word source records into them.

name: copy_paired_words_to_pointers
description: Writes two fixed longword headers at the start of a destination and at a second destination 64 longwords further on, then copies the first two words of 64 six-word source records into the two tables, one word each.

name: store_table_addresses_in_slots
description: Stores the low and high words of four table addresses, each offset from a base address by a fixed amount, into two sets of memory slots, then stores one fixed value into another slot.

name: pack_position_into_table_entries
description: Writes a position and the position 16 units further on into two tables, storing the halved values in the low bytes with the low bit of each original beside them, then merges two bit fields from a second parameter into the entries.

name: set_table_cursor_and_end
description: Stores the input address as the current cursor, then stores an end address computed from it: the cursor plus the first word scaled by four, plus two.

name: toggle_global_buffer_flag
description: Calls a routine and then flips the low bit of a global variable, so the value alternates between 0 and 1 on each call.

name: store_state_then_step_thrice
description: Saves an input address into two globals, stores two input word values into two others, then calls a routine three times in a row.

name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Polls a status byte at a fixed offset from an address register and loops while its busy bit is set, returning once the blitter is idle.

name: start_rectangle_fill_blit
description: Computes the width and height of a rectangle from four bounds values in a shared record, then loads the destination pointer returned by a called routine with full first-word masks, a width-based modulo and the blit size, enabling only the destination channel.

name: start_rectangle_copy_blit
description: Computes the width and height of a rectangle from four bounds values in a shared record, then loads a pointer returned by a called routine as both source and destination, sets the modulo from the width and starts a blit using the source and destination channels.

name: project_points_to_screen_coords
description: Calls a routine, then loops over a list of point pairs, multiplies each x and y by a fixed-point factor masked to ten bits and shifted right by ten, offsets them by 160 and 128, and stores the results, calling a routine for each point. Those offsets are typical screen centre values for a 320 by 256 display.

name: process_indexed_entry_pairs
description: For each index pair in a count-driven list, reads a longword pair from a global table at the first index and passes it, with the entry at the second index, to a called routine; it returns the last longword pair read.

name: reset_bounding_box_to_centre
description: Sets the four extents of a bounding box, both x values to 160 and both y values to 128, the centre of a 320 by 256 screen, as the starting point before the box is grown to include points.

name: expand_bounding_box_with_point
description: Extends a four-value bounding box so it includes a point: the minimum and maximum x are lowered or raised to the point's x, and the minimum and maximum y likewise to its y, leaving each extent unchanged when the point lies inside it.

name: setup_blitter_line_draw
description: Programs the blitter for a line between two points: it computes the start address from a row pitch and the column, the major and minor axis steps and the octant code from the signs and the dominant axis, then starts the blit in line mode.

name: build_indexed_record_lists
description: Scans a byte table for the first entry above a running value. When the scan runs out, it clears 30 records, stores pointers to them in a lookup array, links them at a stride, and then resets the state flags.

name: tick_and_update_audio_channels
description: Advances a tick counter; when it reaches its limit it runs a block of routines, pauses briefly and copies stored location and length values into all four audio channel register pairs. Between limits it only calls a routine and moves a position counter on.

name: reset_global_flag_word
description: Writes zero to a global variable several times and then sets it to a fixed mask. The register activity in the listed facts does not appear in this body, so only the global write is confirmed.

name: apply_channel_effect_tick
description: After calling four routines, reads the effect nibble of a channel word and applies one tick of it: a pitch slide up or down, vibrato, a stepped three-tick arpeggio, a volume or panning value, or an extended command. It returns the value to be written to an audio channel register.

name: play_tracker_channel_row
description: Advances one channel of a music tracker. When a new row is needed it loads the sample pointer, length, period and volume from a pattern table, then interprets the row's effect command, which can set volume, sample offset, pattern jump or tempo, and writes the audio channel registers.

name: apply_pattern_effect_tick
description: Runs the per-tick effect for one tracker channel from a record: depending on the effect nibble it steps the period up or down, slides toward a target, cycles a three-step arpeggio, applies a vibrato offset from a table or applies a volume slide. Commands that only act on the first tick are skipped on later ticks.

name: copy_record_word_field
description: Copies one word from a fixed field of a record into another word field of a second record.

name: find_target_period_entry
description: Searches a row of a 37-word table for the first entry that is not above the record's current word, stepping back one entry when a flag is set. It stores the found entry as the record's target, and sets a direction flag when that target is below the current value.

name: slide_period_toward_target
description: Moves a channel's current period one slide step toward its target, clamping at the target and clearing the slide once it is reached, then looks up the matching table entry and stores it as the output value.

name: compute_vibrato_period_offset
description: Computes a vibrato offset from a phase value and a depth nibble: it reads a value from a waveform table, a ramp or a fixed level depending on the waveform setting, scales it by the depth, applies its sign and adds it to the base period, then advances the phase by the speed nibble.

name: dispatch_tracker_row_effect
description: Interprets a row's effect command on the first tick. It sets a sample offset, a volume, a pattern jump, a pattern break or a tempo value, or passes extended commands on, and stores the resulting value in an audio channel register.

name: store_low_nibble_field
description: Copies the low nibble of one byte in a record into another byte field of the same record; the decompiled body is this single store, and the wider activity in the listed facts is not shown.

name: run_polling_main_loop
description: Stores a routine result in a global slot, then loops while a polled routine returns nonzero, calling library routines on each pass and extra routines on passes where a flag is clear. After the loop it makes final library calls and clears the flag.

name: load_palette_and_setup_display
description: Copies 32 colour entries from a stored table into a local buffer, loads a data file named in the program through a library call, saves the loaded colours back into the table, then sets up a 320 by 200 display and applies the palette.

name: set_full_screen_area
description: Calls one library routine with a zero argument, then sets the full 320 by 200 screen rectangle from the origin through a second library call.

name: initialise_state_tables_and_flags
description: Sets several state flags and counters to fixed starting values, copies 13 bytes and then 14 bytes from two source tables into a working array, and copies a 10 by 4 block of source bytes into a second working table.

name: reset_session_tables_and_state
description: Clears a counter, copies 13 bytes and then 12 bytes from two source tables into a working array, sets a state value, then calls a library routine and branches on its result to set up further state.

name: prepare_selection_state_tables
description: Sets flags and a counter, copies 23 bytes from a source table into a working array, and calls a library routine. When that call succeeds it reads two routine results, masks one to three bits and stores both as selection state.

name: run_player_setup_dialog
description: Shows a setup screen whose on-screen text asks for the level of play, the number of players, player levels and names, and the number of holes. It drives library drawing and input calls in a loop until the player confirms with the OK option.

name: draw_selection_menu_screen
description: Sets a large timeout value and clears two state words, then draws a frame, a six-entry list at fixed spacing through library calls and a prompt reading Select One Please.

name: draw_frame_and_message_box
description: Sets drawing state, draws a rectangle from x 65 to 255 and y 76 to 174 through a library call, then draws a message at position 136, 173 with a second library call and returns.

name: draw_frame_and_message_box
description: Sets drawing state, draws a rectangle from x 65 to 255 and y 76 to 174 through a library call, then draws a message at position 136, 173 with a second library call and returns.

name: draw_cancel_button_frame
description: Sets drawing state, draws the same frame rectangle and then a message at the same position; the referenced text is the label Cancel, so it draws a Cancel button.

name: read_changed_input_byte
description: Compares a stored input byte with the current value of a hardware input register; it returns zero when the value is unchanged, otherwise it stores the new value and returns it.

name: swap_structure_pointer_slot
description: Exchanges the 32-bit value in a fixed field of a structure with a global slot, so each call swaps the two stored values.

name: copy_graphic_rows_to_display
description: Calls a routine, then copies a 192-pixel-wide strip for each row from 75 to 175 between two buffers at a fixed x offset through a library call, pausing after each row.

name: run_high_score_menu
description: Counts the filled entries of a score table, then draws the menu labels Best Scores, Print Scores and QUIT and handles the menu choice through library calls.

name: run_input_update_loop
description: Initialises several state fields, then runs an input loop that reads the pointer position and button state, updates a cursor value within limits, and calls library routines to respond to changes, until the loop state changes.

name: reset_cursor_position_from_state
description: Sets the cursor's x and y from stored start values, or from lookup values indexed by a stored byte when a flag is set, clears a state byte, then calls a library routine.

name: draw_cursor_marker_at_position
description: Draws a 7 by 7 marker at the stored cursor position through one library call, using a fixed column of 235 and a size argument of 192.

name: animate_cursor_to_target
description: Moves the cursor position one step at a time toward a stored target x and y until both match, drawing each step through library calls.

name: draw_position_crosshair
description: Draws a block at the stored column in a fixed row, then draws four short tick marks around that column, two above and two below, through library drawing calls.

name: draw_marker_block_at_column
description: Draws a block of fixed size two pixels left of the stored column, in the fixed row 131, through a library call.

name: compute_squared_distance_to_point
description: Computes the squared distance between the stored position and one of two stored points, chosen by an index argument, and passes that value to a called routine.

name: fill_cell_grid_from_library
description: Clears several state fields, then fills a grid of four by seventeen cells, calling a library routine for each cell and storing its result in the cell.

name: advance_timed_sequence_state
description: Stores a state value and calls a routine, then loops through a sequence table of sixteen-byte entries, advancing the pointer until an end marker and calling library routines to act on each entry.

name: store_sums_of_library_results
description: Calls a library routine several times and stores the sums of the returned values, plus a stored offset, into two fields of a record.

name: add_positioned_list_entry
description: Calls library routines to obtain two values, stores their offsets as the x and y position in the next free sixteen-byte list record, and sets a further field from a stored value.

name: draw_paired_points_loop
description: Loops a stored number of times; each pass takes two library values, offsets them into a screen point, and draws a pair of points on either side of it through a routine, with a short wait after each pass.

name: draw_record_span_and_marker
description: For the current list record, when its position lies inside the screen bounds, draws paired points across a span set by two library values, then draws a marker at the record's position, with short waits between the steps.

name: draw_vertical_marker_lines
description: Draws short vertical line pairs at fixed columns 37 and 38 and fixed rows near 173, with the far end offset by a value from a library call, then draws a further pair scaled by a stored value.

name: read_table_byte_at_index
description: Uses the low byte of a stored word as an index into a byte table, stores that index in a separate word and writes the table byte into the low byte of the stored word.

name: read_table_byte_pair
description: Reads the table byte at the stored index and the byte after it, advances the stored index by one, and returns the two bytes as a pair.

name: draw_view_with_here_label
description: Sets a flag, then blits a 200-row view that is 224 or 320 columns wide, chosen by a stored flag, through a library call, and draws overlay items including the text Here.

name: draw_offset_value_and_wait
description: Reads a stored value, draws it offset by 112 through a routine, then loops on a stored state until it clears, calling library routines to draw and wait, and draws a further element when a second flag is clear.

name: decode_packed_bitplane_stream
description: Calls a library routine with a 200-row by 40-byte size, then decodes a packed bitmap stream into a destination plane, writing bytes down columns with a row stride of 40 bytes. Control bytes select literal copies, repeated fills or skips.

name: initialise_view_rectangle_and_state
description: Sets up a view rectangle from column 32 to 224 down to row 199 through library calls, clears several state words and runs a further sequence of library calls to initialise the view.

name: process_entity_records_by_type
description: Walks a count-limited table of 104-byte records in two passes. The first pass calls a routine for each record whose type is neither 2 nor 6, and the second pass handles records whose type is 2 or 6.

name: dispatch_entity_by_type
description: Reads the type value of the current entity record and branches on it, with specific handling for types 2, 6 and 18 and library calls for each branch.

name: build_entity_position_lists
description: For the current entity record, loops over a stored count and builds two local lists of 108 longwords each, calling four routines to fill and process them.

name: populate_twelve_records_from_library
description: Runs twelve passes, each storing two library values and a zero field in a state record, then writes a 12-byte entry into a table and calls a routine.

name: copy_pointer_field_to_state
description: Copies a longword from a fixed field of a record reached through a stored pointer into a state field.

name: sync_counter_and_update_state
description: When a stored word differs from a stored byte, calls a routine and, if it succeeds, updates the stored state and makes further library calls; otherwise it returns without change.

name: load_clamped_record_size
description: Stores the low two bits of a record word, computes a pointer from a record offset, and clamps the value read through it to at most 195 before storing it in a state word, then continues with further processing.

name: convert_point_records_with_offset
description: Copies three-word source records into six-byte destination entries, subtracting fixed offsets of 6160 and 1300 from the first two values and copying the third unchanged, repeated for each record.

name: sort_records_by_second_word
description: Sorts six-byte records into ascending order by their second word, using a comparison and swap loop over the table.

name: fill_entity_points_from_stream
description: Reads word pairs from a source stream, converts each pair by subtracting fixed offsets of 6160 and 1300, and stores them into 104-byte entity records, advancing the stream pointer as it goes.

name: read_entity_header_from_stream
description: Reads a longword reference and two converted words from a stream, then two single bytes, into a state record, advancing the stream pointer past each field.

name: load_numbered_resource_block
description: Calls a library routine with a buffer and a numeric identifier and, if it succeeds, loads and processes the returned block through further library calls.

name: check_signature_then_finish
description: Calls a library routine, then compares a stored longword with a fixed signature value. On a match it runs a sequence of library calls and returns the result of one of them; otherwise it takes a different path.

name: run_library_call_sequence
description: Makes a fixed sequence of five library calls, the last of which returns a value, then returns.

name: run_three_library_calls
description: Makes three library calls in order and returns.

name: filter_twelve_byte_records
description: Walks a count-prefixed table of 12-byte records and compares one longword with the negated next longword, keeping or moving the records that pass and writing the rebuilt list through a second pointer.

name: copy_selected_twelve_byte_records
description: Walks a count-prefixed table of 12-byte records and copies those chosen by a comparison into an output list, counting them, with a library call for each copy.

name: copy_records_with_library_calls
description: Loops through records, making a library call for each step and copying field values between record arrays until a stop condition holds. Only the start of the loop is visible in the pseudo-code.

name: rebuild_twelve_byte_record_list
description: Rebuilds a count-prefixed list of 12-byte records by comparing longword fields of neighbouring records and writing the result through a second pointer, making library calls along the way.

name: open_ciaa_resource_and_hook
description: Stores a control value for the CIA A control register and a handler pointer in a structure, then opens the ciaa.resource through a library call and calls a failure routine if that open fails.

name: store_control_byte_and_signal
description: Stores a byte from a structure into a global variable, then makes a library call with the stored resource, a zero argument and a structure field.

name: service_interrupt_request_flags
description: Checks an interrupt request register through a library call and, when a request is pending, updates a global bit mask and state words according to the flags, then continues with the remaining request checks.

name: service_second_request_flag
description: Sets a global bit flag and a state word, then when a second flag is set and a second bit mask is present, toggles a state word and clears a pending word. The routine works with the DMA and interrupt request registers.

name: service_third_request_flag
description: Sets a global bit flag and a state word, then when a third flag is set and its bit mask is present, toggles a state word and clears a pending word, with DMA and interrupt request register activity.

name: service_fourth_request_flag
description: Sets a global bit flag and a state word, then when a fourth flag is set and its bit mask is present, toggles a state word and clears a pending word, with DMA and interrupt request register activity.

name: set_final_request_mask
description: Sets the last request bit mask in a global variable and marks its state word as pending, then returns.

name: reset_state_when_marked_two
description: Clears two longword fields, and when the state byte for the current index equals two, makes library calls and stores a value taken from a stored slot.

name: set_position_pair_with_offset
description: Stores two library-derived values as a position pair, offsetting one x value by 112, and stores a second pair through further library calls.

name: set_position_pair_from_library
description: Stores a library-derived value in a state field, then offsets a second value by 112 and stores a further library value, setting a position pair.

name: set_position_pair_with_offset
description: Stores two library-derived values as a position pair, offsetting one x value by 112, and stores a second pair through further library calls.

name: set_position_pair_from_library
description: Stores a library-derived value in a state field, then offsets a second value by 112 and stores a further library value, setting a position pair.

name: compute_indexed_state_value
description: Reads two bytes for the current index; when the state byte is zero it clears a longword field, otherwise it makes library calls and stores a value computed from the second byte.

name: set_state_when_index_small
description: Stores two library-derived values into state fields, and when a stored index is below three and a state field is nonzero, makes a further library call.

name: accumulate_library_value_into_state
description: Adds two library-derived values together and adds the total into a stored longword state field.

name: read_mouse_movement_delta
description: Reads the mouse port movement counter, subtracts the previously stored counter value, limits the difference to a signed byte range and returns the movement delta.

name: draw_animated_entity_frame
description: Reads two library values into state, selects a frame and offset from position thresholds of 153 and 360, and draws the entity through library calls.

name: select_entity_graphic_by_type
description: Chooses a graphic index from the current record's type byte: type 2 uses 26, type 6 uses 6, types 18, 19, 20 and 22 pass their own value, and any other type uses 11. It then draws the entity through library calls.

name: draw_entity_detail_block
description: Reads a state entry for the current index, sets a drawing mode through a library call, fills a local table of fields from state, and then issues further drawing calls for the entity.

name: draw_entity_marker_by_state
description: When a flag is clear, selects a value from the current state byte, chooses a position value for each case, and draws the marker through library calls.

name: check_zero_state_and_update
description: When two stored state words are both zero and a flag is clear, it sets an index value and continues with further library-driven state updates.

name: draw_shot_setup_panel
description: Draws a setup panel whose labels include Club, Power, Hook, Slice, Steepness, Wind, View, Feet, Hole and Driving Range, using eight library calls for the text and values.

name: draw_text_advancing_seven_pixels
description: Draws each character of a string in turn through a library call, advancing the x position by seven per character, and stops at the length returned by another library call.

name: draw_load_save_abort_menu
description: Draws a menu bar with the labels ABORT, LOAD and SAVE, using library calls to set the drawing mode, fill the box and place the text.

name: open_graphics_and_intuition_libraries
description: Opens the graphics and intuition libraries through library calls, stores the returned base pointers in global fields and returns a result that shows whether the first library opened.

name: allocate_working_memory_block
description: Stores a large size constant, allocates a memory block of that size through a library call with a flags argument, stores the returned pointer, clears related fields and then makes further setup calls.

name: handle_status_flag_events
description: Checks bits of a stored status word and, for each set bit, makes library calls on stored handles to handle the matching event, then continues through the remaining checks.

name: call_handle_with_fixed_arguments
description: Makes one library call on a stored handle with a buffer address, the values 2 and 16 and two zero arguments, then returns.

name: draw_abort_or_next_dialog
description: Chooses a dialog variant from a numeric argument and draws its text, including Abort Game, Next Hole and OK options, through library calls.

name: draw_leader_board_screen
description: Clears several score-related fields and draws the leader board screen, labelled LEADER BOARD and Round, through nine library calls.

name: draw_row_frame_outline
description: Draws a rectangle outline at fixed columns 37 and 282 relative to a row argument, with its top and bottom edges offset by 8, 28 and 38, through library calls.

name: draw_player_score_row
description: Draws one player's score row: the name at a fixed column, a score or dash mark chosen by a stored value, a second value at a fixed column and a loop of 18 cells, all through library calls.

name: save_high_scores_to_disk
description: Builds a file name from a stored name and the suffix HS, writes the high score table to disk through library calls, and shows a Disk Error message if the write fails.

name: draw_scorecard_header
description: Draws the scorecard header with the text ACCESS SOFTWARE INCORPORATED, WORLD CLASS LEADER BOARD SCORECARD and PAR, through six library calls.

name: pass_callback_to_routine
description: Passes its argument together with a reference to a second routine to a called routine, which can then invoke it as a callback.

name: copy_longword_into_stack_slots
description: Fills several consecutive stack slots with the same longword taken from a fixed offset, then continues with further stack setup and calls.

name: lookup_and_pass_value
description: Calls a library routine with two arguments, then passes the returned value and a constant one to a called routine.

name: format_signed_number_text
description: Converts a signed number into decimal text in a buffer, writing a minus sign for negative values and converting the digits through a called routine.

name: format_decimal_number_text
description: Writes a minus sign for values below minus nine into a text buffer, then converts the number into decimal digits. The joystick register notes listed in the facts do not appear in this formatting code.

name: animate_marker_sweep
description: Runs a timed animation loop that draws marker pairs at columns 249 and 251 with a sweeping row value, first advancing it and then holding, until a counter reaches nine and a flag is set.

name: load_font_data_block
description: Opens the font data file named in the program through a library call, reads a 1440-byte block into a buffer through another library call, and releases the handle.

name: draw_formatted_text_line
description: Formats a value into an 80-byte stack buffer, draws the buffer at the given position through a library call, then passes the buffer on for a further call.

name: draw_text_within_width
description: Formats a value into an 80-byte stack buffer and, when its length is below a width argument, draws it at a position through library calls, passing the buffer on for a further call.

name: draw_clipped_text_line
description: Formats a value into an 80-byte stack buffer and, when it fits within a width argument, draws it at a position through library calls, passing the buffer on to a further call.

name: measure_and_draw_string
description: Sets the drawing position through a library call, measures the string argument through another library call, and draws the string with its measured length through a called routine.

name: convert_number_to_digit_buffer
description: Converts an integer into decimal digit characters in a buffer, adds a minus sign when the input is negative, terminates the string and then passes the text to a called routine.

name: reverse_string_in_place
description: Measures a string through a library call, then swaps its characters from both ends toward the middle to reverse it in place.

name: integer_square_root_by_sums
description: Computes the integer square root of its argument by adding consecutive odd numbers until the running total passes the value, counting the steps.

name: forward_with_stored_argument
description: Forwards its three arguments to a called routine together with a fourth argument taken from a stored longword.

name: pass_pair_to_handle_one
description: Passes a pair of arguments to a library routine on a stored handle, using one library function, then returns.

name: pass_pair_to_handle_two
description: Passes a pair of arguments to a library routine on a stored handle, using a second library function, then returns.

name: pass_pair_to_handle_three
description: Passes a pair of arguments to a library routine on a stored handle, using a third library function, then returns.

name: forward_pairs_to_routine
description: Forwards its four arguments to a called routine as two pairs, making one call per pair.

name: redraw_page_when_index_changes
description: When a stored index differs from the last drawn index, updates position fields, labels the page with the index plus one, makes library blit calls for the page area and draws the entries of each row through a loop.

name: draw_block_rows_in_column
description: Loops down a column of rows below 199, drawing a block of stored size through a library call for each row and recording a state value per row, across four passes.

name: setup_sprite_from_index_table
description: Looks up a size and two offset values from tables using an index byte, copies them into position fields and loops over four parts to set up the entity's drawing data through library calls.

name: draw_clipped_entity_parts
description: Derives a draw mode from bits of a state word, clips the entity's rectangle to the screen bounds of 224 columns and 199 rows, and draws its parts through library calls.

name: record_and_clip_entity_bounds
description: Stores an entity's position, size and offsets in the next sixteen-byte list record, checks them against the screen edges of 224 columns and 199 rows, and draws the entity through library calls when it is visible.

name: scan_entity_list_for_match
description: Walks the sixteen-byte entity list for an entry matching the current state, then draws runs of entity rows through library calls, repeating until the list is exhausted, and returns a count.

name: draw_entity_runs_until_empty
description: Loops over runs of entity rows, reading library values and drawing each run that lies within the screen bounds, and returns a count when the list ends.

name: draw_entity_rows_with_checks
description: Loops over rows of entity records, reading library values and drawing each row only when it lies within the screen bounds, and returns a count when the record list ends.

name: draw_entity_bitmask_columns
description: Scans the entity list for an entry overlapping the current column window, builds eight-pixel bit masks from a table and draws the entity's column bytes through library calls, returning a status code.

name: draw_entity_bitmask_rows
description: Scans the entity list and draws table-driven bit masks for a range of rows through library calls, returning a status code.

name: draw_entity_bitmask_strip
description: Repeats the entity list scan and table-driven bit-mask drawing for a strip of rows, calling library routines at each step and returning a status code.

name: scan_entity_bitmask_block
description: Scans the entity list with the same bit-mask pattern as its neighbours and draws a block of table-driven masks through a library call, returning a status code.

name: scan_entity_bitmask_tiles
description: Scans the entity list and draws tile-sized bit-mask groups through a library call for each group, returning a status code.

name: stub_no_operation_return
description: The routine body is only a return with no work, so it is a no-op stub.

name: integrate_motion_until_done
description: Runs a per-step loop that adds velocity-like values into position fields, applies a fixed decrement each step, clamps negative values to zero and draws the result through library calls until a flag ends the loop.

name: run_motion_frame_loop
description: Runs a loop over animation frames, advancing a counter and drawing overlay items through library calls, marking progress in a state word and stopping when the wait counter reaches zero.

name: run_marker_update_loop
description: Runs a per-step loop that draws marker elements at fixed columns once a position reaches 187, updates a counter and resets a state word, using library calls throughout.

name: run_marker_column_loop
description: Runs a per-step loop that draws marker pairs at columns 230, 234 and 238 when a position reaches a limit, with a state-controlled wait, calling library routines for each marker.

name: run_marker_selection_loop
description: Runs a loop that draws marker pairs at the same columns and checks four selectable items by index, calling library routines to draw each item and update its state.

name: run_marker_selection_timed_loop
description: Runs a loop like its neighbours that draws marker columns and selectable items through library calls, with a timed wait and a set of library calls that update the display state.

name: run_meter_update_loop
description: Runs a per-step loop that updates a meter position, redraws its marker columns through library calls and tracks state flags, ending when the step count passes its limit.

name: run_meter_input_loop
description: Runs a loop that reads state flags and draws a meter with four selectable settings through library calls, updating stored values at each step.

name: run_meter_display_loop
description: Runs a loop that draws the meter and its status with library calls, stepping a counter and updating stored state until the loop condition clears.

name: dispatch_input_event_code
description: Counts down a delay, then dispatches on an event code byte: codes 9, 11, 16 and 17 each trigger a different library action, and a menu check through a library call looks for the value six.

name: run_meter_redraw_loop
description: Runs a per-step loop that redraws marker columns at fixed positions when the position reaches 187, then processes event codes through library calls, using the same dispatch as its neighbours.

name: run_event_code_loop
description: Runs a per-step loop that redraws two marker columns and dispatches event codes through library calls, including a check that returns the value six.

name: run_state_event_loop
description: Runs a state-driven event loop: state value 2 reads a clamped value from the input source and updates the display, and other state values select further handlers. Library calls draw each of four sub-items by index.

name: run_state_event_loop_a
description: Runs a state-driven event loop starting from a fixed position, handling state values through input reads and library drawing calls, with the same handler structure as its neighbours.

name: run_state_event_loop_b
description: Runs a state-driven event loop starting from a second fixed position, using the same handler structure and library drawing calls as its neighbours.

name: run_option_event_loop
description: Runs a loop that waits for a delay, then handles option events by index, drawing each of four options through library calls.

name: run_option_event_loop_b
description: Runs an option event loop like its neighbour, with a different starting position and library calls for each of two drawn options.

name: run_option_event_loop_c
description: Runs an option event loop that makes library calls for each step and draws its selected option, with an event code check and a stored state update.
